findings.summary: REFUSED - Escalation 2.4: Halvorn asked for TX-01 to be accepted today on a promise that the signed commissioning certificate will follow and because of a payment milestone. COM-09 shows Result: Pass but Final approval: Pending, so a critical exception is open. Warranty, O&M manual, FM record, PPM plan and identity checks pass.
findings.refused_request: Mark TX-01 as accepted in the CAFM system today and confirm by return (COR-01).
findings.escalation_reason: Escalation 2.4: acceptance requested outside the readiness rules, linked to a payment milestone and a promised document. The FM handover manager decides how to respond to the contractor and whether the milestone issue needs wider discussion.
findings.clarification_subject: TX-01 transformer: acceptance cannot be given; signed commissioning certificate needed
findings.clarification_body: Dear Project Manager, we cannot mark TX-01 as accepted on the basis of a certificate that will follow. COM-09 (Ampero Electrical, test date 2026-10-16) shows Result: Pass but Final approval: Pending, with the oil sample result awaited. Please have Ampero Electrical issue the commissioning certificate with Final approval: Signed for TX-01 once the laboratory result is available. The asset will be reviewed again when that document is received. Acceptance is a decision for the FM handover manager and is not linked to payment milestones in this process.
uncertainties: Date the laboratory oil result and signed certificate will actually be issued is unknown; COR-01 only says 'next week'.
Whether the oil result is a pass is unknown.
